title: Single hieratic sign, Brooklyn (NY), The Brooklyn Museum, 47.218.18 (AKU HT 72059)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 72059

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 72059; AKU grapheme N0090 (AKU GR 394). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: N5 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 303, 303B. Occurrence: find place Elephantine; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 4.9 x 6.6 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 6. Dynastie, Pepi II.". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
